lines.zh: : 你给我的[uncle]下药了？！
: 不，我给你的 onii-chan 下药了。

lines.en: : Mwahahaha! The second floor wastes no time in showing everyone how dangerous it can be!
lines.zh: : 哇哈哈哈！二楼可没浪费时间，立刻让大家见识到了它能有多危险！

lines.en: : I feel kind of dizzy all of a sudden...
lines.zh: : 我突然觉得有点晕……
: 啊！老师！撑住！

lines.en: : What in the world have you done, Noriko?!
lines.zh: : Noriko，你到底干了什么？！

lines.en: : I just told you what I did.
lines.zh: : 我刚说了啊。

lines.en: : If there was a “don’t drug your teacher rule,” I would have gladly followed it. I’m just countering in the only way I could think of.
lines.zh: : 要是有“不准给老师下药”这条规则，我当然乐意遵守。我只是在用我唯一能想到的方式反击。

lines.en: : He’ll only be out for a couple minutes anyway. And by the time he wakes up, you’ll all be able to see how a {i}real{/i} little sister treats her big bro.
lines.zh: : 反正他也就昏几分钟。等他醒来，你们就都能看看一个{i}真正{/i}的妹妹是怎么对待她的 onii-chan 的。

lines.en: : This is entirely unacceptable! If that’s how the second floor girls are going to compete, this entire competition is-
lines.zh: : 这完全不可接受！如果二楼的女生要这么比赛，那这场比赛就——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah, yeah. If Sensei thinks it’s so bad, he’ll just pick Ami instead. What’s the big deal?
lines.zh: : 好好好。要是老师觉得这么糟糕，他选 Ami 不就行了。有什么大不了的？

lines.en: : Ami, be a good girl and wait in the living room like Noriko waited for you.
lines.zh: : Ami，乖，去客厅等着，就像 Noriko 等过你那样。

lines.en: : She only waited because she knew he’d pass out after drinking his coffee!
lines.zh: : 她肯等，只是因为她知道他喝完咖啡就会昏过去！
: Onii-chan……醒醒……
: Onii-chan……
: Onii-chan……onii-chan……onii-chan……
: 早上好~
: Noriko？……
: 你……真的给我下药了？

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about, onii-chan.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你在说什么，onii-chan。

lines.en: : You were mumbling in your sleep, so I came in to make sure everything was okay.
lines.zh: : 你说梦话了，所以我进来看看你还好不好。

lines.en: : I was probably mumbling because I was drugged.
lines.zh: : 我会说梦话，大概是因为被下药了。

lines.en: : Are you sure you weren’t just having a perverted dream about your little sister?...
lines.zh: : 你确定不是只做了一个关于你妹妹的变态梦？……
: 你好色哦，onii-chan……

lines.en: : But if it makes you feel any better...
lines.zh: : 不过要是这能让你好受一点的话……

lines.en: : I had a dream like that too...
lines.zh: : 我也做了那样的梦……

lines.en: : Okay, that’s enough. Noriko, get off the bed-
lines.zh: : 好，够了。Noriko，从床上下来——

lines.en: : Wait wait wait! We let Ami go the full ten minutes and she said some weird stuff too! You’re being biased toward your floor! I will not stand for it!
lines.zh: : 等等等等！我们让 Ami 完整地做了十分钟，她也说了些奇怪的话！你对你们楼层有偏心！我绝不答应！

lines.en: : Noriko, give him all you’ve got!
lines.zh: : Noriko，使出你的全部本事！

lines.en: : You’re really okay with just sitting back and watching her say things like that?!
lines.zh: : 你真的就这么坐着看她说那种话？！
: 那既不道德又恶心，而且——
: Onii-chan？……你怎么不说话？
: 你的心又飘走了吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Right now, it’s somewhere between being under the influence and potentially ruining at least two different relationships before the first contest is over.
lines.zh: : 是的。此刻，它介于药劲未过、和在第一场比赛结束前就可能毁掉至少两段关系之间。

lines.en: Noriko giggles and slides herself forward, lightly grinding her lower body against one of my legs...
lines.zh: Noriko 咯咯笑着往前蹭了蹭，把下半身轻轻压在我的一条腿上磨蹭……

lines.en: Her voice gets quieter and more seductive.
lines.zh: 她的声音变得更轻、更勾人。

lines.en: And, in other news, I love the dorm war.
lines.zh: 另外插播一条：我爱死宿舍战争了。

lines.en: : You know, onii-chan...Mom and Dad aren’t home right now...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，onii-chan……爸爸妈妈现在都不在家……

lines.en: : So if you’re worried about ruining things with them...you don’t have to be...
lines.zh: : 所以要是你担心会跟他们闹僵……你不必担心……

lines.en: : Besides, I see no harm in doing a little...{i}experimenting{/i} with you...
lines.zh: : 再说，我觉得跟你做一点……{i}实验{/i}也没什么坏处……

lines.en: : I’m at that age where I’ve been thinking about all sorts of {i}naughty{/i} stuff...and I have no idea what I’m supposed to do about it...
lines.zh: : 我正处在那个会想各种各样{i}下流{/i}东西的年纪……而我完全不知道自己该怎么办……
: 你很聪明……对吧，onii-chan？……

lines.en: : Can you teach me how to relieve some of those strange urges I’ve been having?...
lines.zh: : 你能教我怎么缓解那些我最近一直有的奇怪冲动吗？……

lines.en: : Hey! What’s going on in there?! Why is the door locked?!
lines.zh: : 喂！里面在搞什么？！门为什么锁着？！

lines.en: : Noriko, as much as I am enjoying this, we should probably-
lines.zh: : Noriko，虽然我很享受，但我们大概该——

lines.en: : Do it quick? If that’s what you think is best, onii-chan...
lines.zh: : 快点做？如果你觉得那样最好，onii-chan……

lines.en: : We can always wait for another day for you to...teach {i}me{/i} things...
lines.zh: : 你也可以改天再……教{i}我{/i}那些事……

lines.en: : For now...why not let your little sister {i}help you out?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 现在嘛……为什么不让你妹妹{i}帮你解决一下？……{/i}
: Noriko！马上停下！

lines.en: : Did you seriously get hard for your little sister? Pervert...
lines.zh: : 你真的对你妹妹硬了？变态……
: 啊！我的眼睛！
: 我还没准备好！

lines.en: : Come on! You guys are really killing the mood right now!
lines.zh: : 拜托！你们两个真是太败兴了！
: 对吧，onii-chan？！

lines.en: : Tell them you want some private time with your little sister!
lines.zh: : 告诉她们你想跟妹妹独处一会儿！

lines.en: : Could you two maybe leave the room for like, three minutes?
lines.zh: : 你们两个能不能出去个……三分钟？

lines.en: : Absolutely not! I’m unlocking the door and letting Ami back in.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行！我要把门打开，让 Ami 进来。

lines.en: : Noriko, get off of Sensei right now. This contest is officially over.
lines.zh: : Noriko，马上从老师身上下来。这场比赛正式结束。
: 里面在干什么？！

lines.en: : Uhh, nothing! Just some...wholesome brother and sister bonding!
lines.zh: : 呃，没什么！只是一些……健康的兄妹交流！

lines.en: : Noriko totally didn’t try to grab Sensei’s-
lines.zh: : Noriko 绝对没有想抓老师的——

lines.en: : Glasses! She tried to put his glasses on!
lines.zh: : 眼镜！她想帮他把眼镜戴上！

lines.en: : And...as someone who understands the importance of...vision...I could not allow the contest to proceed!
lines.zh: : 而……作为一个懂得……视力……重要性的人，我不能再让比赛继续下去！

lines.en: : Oh. It sounded like something else happened, but I guess Noriko’s smart enough to know her place and not try anything she shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 哦。听起来像是发生了别的事，不过我想 Noriko 够聪明，知道自己的分寸，不会做不该做的事。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, onii-chan...it looks like our parents came home earlier than expected...
lines.zh: : 抱歉啦，onii-chan……看来我们的爸妈比预想的回来得早……

lines.en: : But feel free to dream about me again tonight, okay?
lines.zh: : 不过今晚你尽可以再梦我一次，好吗？

lines.en: : Maybe I can give you another pair of my panties to help you out?
lines.zh: : 也许我还能再给你一条我的内裤，帮帮你？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure it’s just roleplay again, but...
lines.zh: : 我敢说那又是角色扮演，不过……

lines.en: : She kinda drugged him. So I don’t think anything is off the table right now.
lines.zh: : 她可是给他下了药。所以我觉得现在什么都可能发生。

lines.en: : So, uhh...that was definitely...one way for this competition to go.
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……这场比赛确实是……一种走向。

lines.en: : No matter what happens, I am satisfied with the result.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么样，我对结果很满意。

lines.en: : Why did we even let this particular contest happen in the first place? Of course it was going to end like this...
lines.zh: : 我们当初到底为什么同意办这个比赛？它当然会这样收场……

lines.en: : Next time you drug my [uncle], don’t lock me out of the room.
lines.zh: : 下次你给我[uncle]下药的时候，别把我锁在门外。
: 下次？

lines.en: : Got it. We’ll share him if I do it again, like good little sisters should.
lines.zh: : 明白了。要是我再干一次，我们会分享他的，就像好妹妹该做的那样。

lines.en: : Why is everyone except Makoto so accepting of this? You could have killed me.
lines.zh: : 为什么除了 Makoto 之外所有人都这么接受这件事？你可能会害死我。
: 我看你挺精神的。

lines.en: : And your {i}glasses{/i} certainly felt fine, if you don’t mind me saying that.
lines.zh: : 而且你的{i}眼镜{/i}摸起来确实挺精神的，要是你不介意我这么说的话。

lines.en: : What does that even mean? Just hurry up and tell me I won so we can move onto the next contest.
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么意思？快点宣布我赢了，好让我们进行下一场比赛。

lines.en: : Agreed. It pains me to say this, but the sooner we name Ami the victor, the better.
lines.zh: : 同意。虽然说出来很痛苦，但我们越早宣布 Ami 获胜越好。

lines.en: : Hey, hold on a sec! Noriko may have played dirty, but she was still a great little sister!
lines.zh: : 嘿，等一下！Noriko 虽然耍了阴招，但她仍然是个很棒的妹妹！

lines.en: : Just imagine wakin’ up to something like that! If you were a boy, you’d be over the moon!
lines.zh: : 光是想象醒来看到那一幕！你要是个男生，肯定会乐疯的！

lines.en: : She literally {i}drugged{/i} him. And we don’t even know what she gave him or where she got it from.
lines.zh: : 她{i}真的下药{/i}了。而且我们甚至不知道她给他下了什么、从哪儿弄来的。

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter. It’s over and done with. Just hurry up and pick a winner, onii-chan.
lines.zh: : 无所谓。事情都过去了。快点选个赢家吧，onii-chan。
"Ami 获胜"：

lines.en: : Well, it probably comes as no surprise, but the winner of the apparent little sister contest is Ami.
lines.zh: : 嗯，大概一点也不意外，这场所谓的妹妹比赛的赢家是 Ami。
: 哈！那是当然。

lines.en: : True love always prevails. But don’t get so down about it, Noriko. I’ve been practicing for this contest since the moment Sensei took me in.
lines.zh: : 真爱总会胜出。不过别太难过，Noriko。从老师收留我的那一刻起，我就在为这场比赛练习了。

lines.en: : But...I’ve also been kind of like a little sister to you for basically forever.
lines.zh: : 不过……我基本上从很久以前起，就一直像个妹妹一样对你了。
: 我做错了什么？
: Noriko，你可是给我下了药啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, there was no way you were going to win after making a move like that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你出了那一招之后，根本不可能赢。

lines.en: : A real little sister thinks about her brother’s health before anything else.
lines.zh: : 一个真正的妹妹会把哥哥的健康放在第一位。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have had to do that if I had gotten to go first! Just...waking him up was a part of my plan and I knew what I gave him was safe and...yeah.
lines.zh: : 要是我能先上场，我就不用那么做了！只是……叫醒他本来就是我计划的一部分，而且我知道自己给他吃的东西是安全的，还有……算了。
: 不过这还没完！

lines.en: : Ami may have won the little sister contest, but it would have been completely different if we were fighting over who the better girlfriend would be!
lines.zh: : Ami 也许赢了妹妹比赛，但要是我们比的是谁更适合当女朋友，结果就会完全不同！

lines.en: : Noriko, I wouldn’t want a girlfriend to drug me either.
lines.zh: : Noriko，我也不希望有个女朋友给我下药。
: 我会记住的！
"Noriko 获胜"：

lines.en: : The winner of the apparent little sister contest or whatever this was called...is Noriko.
lines.zh: : 这场所谓的妹妹比赛、或者随便它叫什么……的赢家，是 Noriko。
: 什么？
: 太好了！
: 太好了！
: 你……他妈的疯了吗？

lines.en: : Are you really just overlooking what she did?
lines.zh: : 你真的就这么无视她做过的事？

lines.en: : No. What she did was inexcusable and it’s a miracle she won with that in mind.
lines.zh: : 不是。她做的事不可原谅，而考虑到这一点她还能赢，简直是个奇迹。

lines.en: : Hey, what kind of victory speech is this? I want to be praised and stuff.
lines.zh: : 喂，这算什么获胜感言？我可是想被夸一夸什么的。

lines.en: : The reason Noriko wins is that she just felt like a more authentic little sister to me.
lines.zh: : Noriko 赢的原因是，她让我感觉更像一个真实的妹妹。

lines.en: : {i}That{/i} was your idea of authentic? Roleplay like that is arguably the least authentic thing that exists.
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}就是你对“真实”的理解？那种角色扮演大概算得上世上最不真实的东西了。

lines.en: : It was certainly...a thing. Though, I definitely enjoyed it.
lines.zh: : 那确实是……一回事。不过，我确实很享受。

lines.en: : Same. I would have kept going if we weren’t stopped, too.
lines.zh: : 我也是。要是我们没被打断，我也会继续下去的。

lines.en: : The thing is, Ami’s portion of the contest was just more of...Ami being Ami.
lines.zh: : 问题是，Ami 那部分比赛只是更像……Ami 本来的样子。
: 不过……
: 不过你爱我……

lines.en: : Obviously. But to me, it was like you were just being my [niece] like always and slapping an “onii-chan” sticker on it.
lines.zh: : 显然。但对我来说，那就像你只是在像往常一样当我的[niece]，然后往上面贴了张“onii-chan”的贴纸。
: 可是……我可是编了一整套背景故事的……

lines.en: : True, but Noriko actually felt like a different person.
lines.zh: : 没错，但 Noriko 真的让我感觉像是另一个人。

lines.en: : So...I lost because...I’m too good at being your [niece] to be seen as anything else?
lines.zh: : 所以……我输了，是因为……我太擅长当你的[niece]，以至于没法被看成别的什么？

lines.en: : If that’s how you want to rationalize it, sure.
lines.zh: : 你要是非这么想，也行。
: 不过你们两个都很棒。

lines.en: : Well...it feels a little better when you put it like that...but I still don’t like this...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你这么一说我好受一点了……但我还是不喜欢这样……

lines.en: : I wouldn’t worry, Ami. Sensei’s probably always looked at me like a little sister anyway, so my portion of the contest was probably just him living out some fantasy of his.
lines.zh: : 别担心啦，Ami。老师大概一直都把我当妹妹看，所以我的那部分比赛大概只是他在实现自己的某种幻想。

lines.en: : You know, I can’t say there are any fantasies of mine that involve being drugged.
lines.zh: : 你知道的，我还真说不出自己有什么幻想是跟被下药有关的。

lines.en: : I’m sure there will be at least {i}one{/i} after this morning, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我敢说，经过今天早上，以后至少会有{i}一个{/i}了。

lines.en: : Let’s just...stop talking about this contest altogether and move on...
lines.zh: : 我们就……别再聊这场比赛了，往前走吧……

lines.en: : I absolutely can not be the only person extremely uncomfortable right now.
lines.zh: : 我绝对不可能是现在唯一觉得极度不适的人。

lines.en: : For once, I actually agree with Makoto.
lines.zh: : 这一次，我还真同意 Makoto。

lines.en: : Let’s just get dressed and...walk to the park...
lines.zh: : 我们赶紧穿好衣服……走去公园吧……

lines.en: Makoto and Uta head out before the rest of us so they can relay the results of the match to their teams.
lines.zh: Makoto 和 Uta 先我们一步出发，好把比赛结果带回给各自的队伍。

lines.en: I’m ready before Ami and Noriko are, but I still decide to wait for them near the front door so we can all walk to the park together.
lines.zh: 我比 Ami 和 Noriko 都先准备好，但我还是决定在前门附近等她们，好让我们一起走去公园。

lines.en: I’m sure it would be significantly more awkward if it were just the two of them, so I’m hoping my presence is able to quell some of the unease.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，要是只有她们两个，气氛会尴尬得多，所以我希望我的在场能缓解一些不自在。

lines.en: It’s not really easy to just choose between two girls you like, especially when you know how sensitive both of them are.
lines.zh: 要在两个你都喜欢的女生之间做选择，本来就不容易，尤其是当你知道她们两个都很敏感的时候。

lines.en: But it’s still just a game at the end of the day. And I’m sure that the result of this match won’t have any long lasting effects on their relationship.
lines.zh: 不过说到底，这仍然只是一场游戏。而我相信这场比赛的结果不会对她们之间的关系产生什么长久的影响。

lines.en: Or my relationship with them, for that matter.
lines.zh: 对我和她们的关系也一样。

lines.en: They’ll both continue to be head over heels in love with me-
lines.zh: 她们两个会继续为我神魂颠倒——

lines.en: And I will continue to absorb their feelings until there is nothing left of them.
lines.zh: 而我会继续吸收她们的感情，直到她们什么都不剩。
